item_title: Mayor and Council Excused Absence Requests
document_text:
Action: Upon motion by Councilmember Michael Mulcahy, seconded by Councilmember Pamela Campos, and carried unanimously, the Consent Calendar was approved as a whole, and the following actions were taken as indicated. (11-0-0)

2.4 Mayor and Council Excused Absence Requests.
Request for an excused absence for Councilmember Kamei from the regular meeting of Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole on December 3, 2025, due to authorized City business to attend the Local Agency Formation Commission of Santa Clara County (Santa Clara LAFCO) meeting.

Action: The request for an excused absence for Councilmember Kamei from the regular meeting of Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole on December 3, 2025 was approved. (11-0-0)
